verdicts.note: District Court judge since 2013, retained three times (S1, S4), presiding judge, dean of the state Judicial College and a 2024 leadership award (S1, S2). That is the maximal proven-record case, so -2 at high holds.

Attacked toward +1: he is a career prosecutor who has practiced in this very court (S1, S2), not a stranger to the system. But on the judicial axis the relevant record is the bench, where he has none. His statement explicitly runs on renewal against a 13-year incumbent: 'It is time for a fresh perspective and a positive change' and 'restore confidence' (S1, S3). Explicit and repeated renewal framing supports +2 at high.

Permitted basis: professional formation as a felony prosecutor in three counties (S1, S2), and endorsers who are mostly prosecutors, victim advocates and corrections staff (S4). He pledges convicted offenders 'will be held responsible' and to hold them accountable in a 'decisive manner' (S1, S3). Contrary evidence: he says decisions balance 'punishment, treatment options and community safety' (S5), and one endorser is a defense attorney (S4). That keeps this at -1, not -2. He has no bail or sentencing record, so medium confidence.
